title: On the Great Alkali Plain
question: Today, what will a dying man agree to for a mouthful of water?
palette: Bleached high-key palette of bone white, alkali grey and pale dust, hard black shadows under a white sun, wide empty distance; the alkali flats of Utah Territory, 4 May 1847; American frontier, sunlight only.

plain_vista.described: The great alkali plain seen from the northern slope of the Sierra Blanco, 4 May 1847: a flat grey-white salt plain running unbroken to the horizon, dusted over with patches of powdery white alkali and cut by clumps of dwarfish grey chaparral scrub, a rutted waggon track winding away across it and lost in the distance, scattered white bones lying bleached beside the ruts, a long chain of bare mountain peaks flecked with snow along the far edge, a bare steel-blue sky burned pale at the horizon, and the white afternoon sun of a cloudless May day stands high and a little behind the camera, throwing short hard black shadows straight down off every rock
plain_vista.landmark: the chain of snow-flecked peaks along the far horizon
plain_vista.landmark_size: is the height of a thumbnail
plain_vista.route: from the bare rock of the near slope out along the rutted track to the far peaks
plain_vista.geometry: The steel-blue sky fills the TOP third of frame with the snow-flecked peaks along its lower edge at the height of a thumbnail, the flat grey-white plain runs from those peaks down through the CENTRE to the BOTTOM of frame, the rutted waggon track winds away up the CENTRE and narrows to a thread at the peaks, and bleached white bones lie scattered beside the ruts at the BOTTOM

crag_top.described: The little plateau crowning a barren hill above the alkali plain, 1847: bare grey rock underfoot scoured clean, a single giant boulder standing on the plateau with one shaded face, a long rifle laid down on the rock, a grey woollen shawl spread open on the ground, a ledge of rock standing above the boulder, the grey-white plain falling away beyond the edge, and the white afternoon sun of a cloudless May day stands high and a little behind the camera, throwing short hard black shadows straight down off every rock
crag_top.landmark: the single giant boulder on the plateau
crag_top.landmark_size: is half the height of the frame
crag_top.route: from the shaded foot of the boulder across the bare rock to the edge of the plateau where the plain falls away
crag_top.geometry: The giant boulder stands at the LEFT of frame from the BOTTOM to the TOP with its shaded face toward the camera, the bare grey rock of the plateau runs from the BOTTOM of frame away to the RIGHT, the ledge of rock stands across the TOP RIGHT at the height of a standing man, and the grey-white plain lies beyond the plateau edge at the RIGHT below the horizon

caravan_far.described: The alkali plain at the foot of the barren hill, 1847, seen from the plateau: the flat grey-white salt plain running out to the horizon, a wide column of pale dust standing up off it and drifting, the small dark shapes of canvas-tilted waggons and mounted men showing through the haze in a straggling line that runs right across the plain from edge to edge, the snow-flecked peaks beyond, and the white afternoon sun of a cloudless May day stands high and a little behind the camera, throwing short hard black shadows straight down off every rock
caravan_far.landmark: the column of pale dust standing off the plain
caravan_far.landmark_size: is half the height of the frame
caravan_far.route: from the plateau edge out across the plain to the head of the dust column
caravan_far.geometry: The steel-blue sky holds the TOP of frame, the column of pale dust stands up from the plain across the CENTRE at half the height of the frame, the straggling line of dark waggons and mounted men runs through the dust from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge at the height of a thumbnail, and the flat grey-white plain holds the BOTTOM of frame

caravan_column.described: The middle of the Mormon caravan on the alkali plain, 1847: heavy waggons with white canvas tilts stretched over their hoops, teams of dusty oxen in the yoke, spoked wheels turning in the powdery white alkali, men on horseback in sombre brown and grey homespun riding alongside with rifles slung, the churned dust hanging at knee height over everything, and the white afternoon sun of a cloudless May day stands high and a little behind the camera, throwing short hard black shadows straight down off every rock
caravan_column.landmark: the nearest white canvas waggon tilt
caravan_column.route: from the flank of the nearest waggon forward along the column to the head of it
caravan_column.geometry: The white canvas tilt of the nearest waggon stands at the LEFT of frame from the height of a standing man to the TOP, the line of following waggons runs away to the RIGHT and narrows toward the horizon, mounted men ride between them at the height of a standing man and a half, the churned white dust hangs across the BOTTOM of frame at knee height, and the steel-blue sky holds the TOP RIGHT
caravan_column.crowd: some twenty pale-faced women in plain bonnets walk beside the wheels carrying bundles, and small children walk at their skirts or look out from under the white canvas

bluff_base.described: The foot of the barren bluff where it meets the alkali plain, 1847: bare broken rock rising steeply on the LEFT into a precipitous slope of ledges, the flat grey-white plain opening on the RIGHT, a score of mounted men halted on the powdery ground in sombre brown and grey homespun with rifles slung across their backs, their horses standing dusty and blown, and the white afternoon sun of a cloudless May day stands high and a little behind the camera, throwing short hard black shadows straight down off every rock
bluff_base.landmark: the rugged crag at the top of the slope
bluff_base.landmark_size: is the height of a hand
bluff_base.route: from the powdery ground at the horses' feet up the ledges of the slope to the crag at the top
bluff_base.geometry: The broken rock of the bluff rises from the BOTTOM LEFT to the TOP of frame with the crag at its summit at the height of a hand, the mounted men stand across the CENTRE of frame at the height of a standing man and a half, the flat grey-white plain opens away at the RIGHT below the horizon, and the powdery white ground holds the BOTTOM of frame
bluff_base.crowd: a dozen more mounted men in homespun sit their horses further back along the foot of the bluff with their rifles across the saddle

young_waggon.described: The great leading waggon of the Mormon caravan halted on the alkali plain, 1847: a heavy waggon far larger than the rest with a bright white canvas tilt and its bodywork painted and varnished, six horses yoked to it in three pairs standing in the powdery white dust, a broad plank driver's seat across the front of the tilt with a brown-backed volume laid on it, the line of lesser waggons standing behind, and the white afternoon sun of a cloudless May day stands high and a little behind the camera, throwing short hard black shadows straight down off every rock
young_waggon.landmark: the white canvas tilt of the great waggon
young_waggon.route: from the powdery ground at the wheel forward past the six yoked horses to the head of the team
young_waggon.geometry: The white canvas tilt of the great waggon fills the TOP and RIGHT of frame from the height of a standing man upward, the broad plank driver's seat runs across the CENTRE at the height of a standing man's head with the brown-backed volume laid on it, the six yoked horses stand away to the LEFT at the height of a standing man, and the powdery white dust holds the BOTTOM of frame
young_waggon.crowd: a crowd of some thirty men and women in plain homespun stands back from the waggon wheel looking toward the seat

shots.frame: Wide of the great alkali plain from the northern slope: the flat grey-white salt plain running unbroken to a chain of snow-flecked peaks on the horizon, a rutted waggon track winding away across it, scattered white bones bleaching beside the ruts, under a steel-blue sky burned pale at the horizon.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back off the plain across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the heat shimmer rises off the salt in the middle distance; a thin skein of white dust lifts along the track where the wind takes it.
shots.camera: on the bare rock of the northern slope, level with a standing man's eye and four long strides above the plain, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: The steel-blue sky fills the TOP third of frame with snow-flecked peaks along its lower edge at the height of a thumbnail, the flat grey-white plain runs from those peaks down through the CENTRE to the BOTTOM, a rutted waggon track winds away up the CENTRE, and scattered white bones lie beside the ruts at the BOTTOM
shots.turn: a country -> a country that kills

shots.frame: Insert on the rutted track: the bleached white skull and ribs of an ox half buried in powdery alkali beside a wheel rut that runs away to the TOP of frame, and the smaller bones of a man lying beyond them at the TOP RIGHT at the height of a thumb in the same white dust.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the bones across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; the powdery alkali drifts across the rib cage where the wind crosses it; the shadow of the skull shortens under the high sun.
shots.camera: down at the edge of the wheel rut, level with a man's knee and a stride from the skull, an 85mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A bleached ox skull and rib cage fill the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height half buried in powdery white alkali, a wheel rut runs away behind them to the TOP of frame, smaller human bones lie beyond at the TOP RIGHT at the height of a thumb, and the white dust holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: a country that kills -> the ones it killed

shots.frame: Full of the plateau: a tall gaunt man in a dark velveteen tunic standing at the shaded foot of a giant boulder with a long rifle hanging down from one hand, the bare grey rock running away past him to the plateau edge, and the plain far below beyond it.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the man across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; he turns his head from the plain to the north and back; the heat shimmer moves on the rock behind him.
shots.camera: on the bare rock of the plateau, level with a standing man's chest and five long strides from the boulder, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A giant boulder stands at the LEFT of frame from the BOTTOM to the TOP with its shaded face toward the camera, a tall gaunt man in a dark velveteen tunic stands at its foot at the CENTRE at four fifths of the frame height with a long rifle hanging down from his right hand, the bare grey rock runs away to the RIGHT, and the plain lies far below beyond the plateau edge at the RIGHT
shots.turn: the ones it killed -> the one it is killing

shots.frame: Close on the man's face: the sun-darkened skin drawn tight over the cheekbones, deep-set eyes narrowed against the glare, a long brown beard flecked white, the cracked lips closed, the shaded boulder behind him.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on his face across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; his eyes come round off the far distance; his head comes down toward the rock at his feet.
shots.camera: on the plateau at the boulder, level with a standing man's eye and two long strides from his face, an 85mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A gaunt sun-darkened face fills the CENTRE of frame at two thirds of the frame height with deep-set eyes narrowed and a long white-flecked brown beard below them, the shaded face of the boulder stands behind at the LEFT, and a strip of steel-blue sky shows at the TOP RIGHT
shots.turn: the one it is killing -> what he is carrying

shots.frame: Medium of the shaded ground at the boulder's foot: the long rifle laid down on the bare rock, and a bundle tied up in a grey woollen shawl set down beside it, the man's hands still on the knot.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the bundle across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; his two hands come off the knot and open; the grey shawl falls open where his hands leave it.
shots.camera: at the foot of the boulder, level with a kneeling man's chest and two long strides from the bundle, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A bundle tied in a grey woollen shawl sits at the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height on bare grey rock, a long rifle lies beside it at the LEFT, two gaunt bare hands rest on the knot at the CENTRE, and the shaded face of the boulder fills the TOP of frame
shots.turn: what he is carrying -> who

shots.frame: Close on the opened shawl: a small pale face with very bright brown eyes looking up out of the grey wool, a mass of tousled golden curls around it, and two small dimpled fists closed on the shawl's edge.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back off the child's face across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; her eyes come open wider and fix on the man above the camera; one fist opens on the wool.
shots.camera: at the opened shawl, level with a kneeling child's eye and a long stride from her face, an 85mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A small pale child's face fills the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with very bright brown eyes and a mass of tousled golden curls around it, grey woollen shawl lies open around her at the BOTTOM and both edges, and two small closed fists rest on the wool at the BOTTOM CENTRE
shots.turn: who -> a child of five

shots.frame: Insert on the child's feet against the bare rock: two neat dark shoes with shining buckles over clean white socks, the hem of a pink frock above them, the grey shawl and the scoured grey stone under.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the shoes across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; one foot turns over on its side against the rock; the shawl fringe lifts where the wind crosses it.
shots.camera: down at the spread shawl, level with a seated child's ankle and a long stride from her feet, an 85mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: Two neat dark shoes with shining buckles stand at the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height over clean white socks, the hem of a pink frock lies above them at the TOP, grey shawl runs to both edges, and scoured grey rock holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: a child of five -> somebody dressed her this morning

shots.frame: Medium close of the child sitting up on the spread shawl: a girl of five in a bright pink frock with a small white linen apron over it, white socks and neat dark shoes with shining buckles, one hand rubbing the back of her golden head.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the child across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; her hand comes down off her head and holds it out toward the man; her chin comes up.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock beside the shawl, level with a seated child's eye and three long strides from her, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A girl of five in a bright pink frock and a white linen apron sits at the CENTRE of frame at three quarters of the frame height on a spread grey shawl, one hand is up at the back of her golden head at the height of her own ear, neat dark shoes with shining buckles stand at the BOTTOM, and bare grey rock runs to both edges
shots.turn: a child of five -> a child who does not know

shots.frame: Insert on the man's hand lying open on the bare rock: a gaunt brown hand with the tendons standing up under the skin, the fingers half curled, a small dark shoe standing on the rock a little beyond it.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the open hand across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; the fingers close a thumb's width onto the rock; the pale dust runs off the knuckles where the wind takes it.
shots.camera: down at the plateau rock, level with a crouching man's knee and a long stride from his hand, an 85mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A gaunt brown open hand fills the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height on scoured grey rock with the tendons standing up under the skin, a small dark shoe stands beyond it at the TOP RIGHT at the height of a thumb, and bare rock runs to both edges
shots.turn: the telling -> the hand that has to do it

shots.frame: Medium close of the gaunt man crouched on the rock facing the child, his forearms across his knees, the cracked lips parted and still, the shaded boulder rising behind his shoulder.
shots.motion: The camera tracks a hand's breadth to the left across the whole shot; his head comes down and turns away from her; his hands come down open onto the rock.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock beside the shawl, level with a crouching man's eye and three long strides from him, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A gaunt bearded man crouches at the CENTRE of frame at four fifths of the frame height with his forearms across his knees and his hands open, the shaded face of the boulder rises behind his shoulder at the LEFT, and bare grey rock holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: a child who does not know -> the telling

shots.frame: Full of the child from behind on the plateau: a small pink figure sitting alone on the spread grey shawl with her golden head down, the bare rock running away past her, and the whole white plain opening below and beyond her.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back off the child across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; her shoulders come up and down once; the heat shimmer crosses the plain behind her.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock behind her, level with a seated child's head and four long strides back, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A small pink figure sits at the CENTRE of frame at a third of the frame height on a spread grey shawl with her golden head down and her back to the camera, bare grey rock runs away from the BOTTOM of frame past her, and the white plain opens beyond her at the TOP below the horizon
shots.turn: the crying -> how small she is out here

shots.frame: Close on the child's face with the white linen pinafore come up over the lower half of it, only the bright brown eyes and the tousled golden curls showing above the cloth, the grey shawl behind her.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on her face across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; the pinafore comes down off her face in both fists; her chin lifts.
shots.camera: beside the spread shawl, level with a seated child's eye and two long strides from her face, an 85mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A child's face fills the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with a white linen pinafore up across the lower half of it in two small fists, bright brown eyes and tousled golden curls stand above the cloth, and grey woollen shawl fills the BOTTOM and both edges
shots.turn: the telling -> the crying

shots.frame: Medium two-shot on the shawl: the girl in the pink frock sitting up with her face clear and laughing, the gaunt bearded man crouched beside her looking at her, the bare rock and the shaded boulder behind them both.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the two of them across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; her face comes round to his and her mouth opens laughing; his head comes up off his chest.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock, level with a seated child's eye and four long strides from the shawl, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A girl of five in a pink frock sits at the LEFT of CENTRE at three quarters of the frame height with her face turned up and clear, a gaunt bearded man crouches at the RIGHT at four fifths of the frame height looking at her, the shaded boulder fills the TOP RIGHT, and the spread grey shawl holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: the crying -> the laughing

shots.frame: Wide of the whole plateau from out over the drop: the giant boulder standing on the bare crown of the hill with two small figures at its foot, one dark and one pink, and the white plain running away below them to the far peaks.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back off the plateau across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the two small figures hold their places at the boulder's foot; the heat shimmer runs along the plain below them.
shots.camera: out beyond the plateau edge, level with the crown of the hill and six long strides from the boulder, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A giant boulder stands at the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height on the bare crown of a hill, two small figures sit at its foot at the CENTRE at the height of a thumb, one dark and one pink, the white plain runs away below them to the BOTTOM of frame, and the far peaks stand at the TOP at the height of a thumbnail
shots.turn: the laughing -> two people and nothing else

shots.frame: Wide of the steel-blue sky above the plateau: three small dark specks turning in a wide circle high over the rock, the edge of the giant boulder standing up into the bottom corner of frame.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the specks across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the three specks turn on the circle and grow; the heat shimmer crosses the rock edge below them.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock looking up, level with a lying man's eye and four long strides from the boulder edge, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: Steel-blue sky fills the frame, three small dark specks turn at the CENTRE at the height of a thumbnail each, and the grey edge of the giant boulder stands up into the BOTTOM LEFT corner at a third of the frame height
shots.turn: the laughing -> what is coming

shots.frame: Medium of the rock ledge above the boulder: three turkey vultures settled along it in a row, blackish-brown plumage hunched and wings folded, each bare red head turned down toward the camera, the steel-blue sky behind them.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the birds across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; the nearest bird's bare red head turns further down toward the camera; the wind lifts the ragged feathers along its folded wing.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock below the ledge, level with a standing man's eye and four long strides from the ledge, an 85mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: Three turkey vultures stand in a row across the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height on a grey rock ledge with blackish-brown plumage and bare red heads turned down, the grey rock of the ledge runs to both edges at the BOTTOM, and steel-blue sky fills the TOP
shots.turn: what is coming -> it is already here

shots.frame: Medium close of the girl on the bare rock, her face come round toward the camera bright and delighted, both hands raised beside her golden head mid-clap, the pink frock bright against the grey stone, the boulder behind her.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back off the child across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; her two raised hands come together in a clap; her heels come up off the rock.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock, level with a standing child's eye and three long strides from her, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A girl of five in a bright pink frock stands at the CENTRE of frame at four fifths of the frame height with her face turned up and both hands raised above her golden head, the shaded boulder rises behind her at the LEFT, and bare grey rock holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: it is already here -> she thinks they are hens

shots.frame: Full of the spread grey shawl on the bare rock: the girl in the pink frock and the gaunt bearded man kneeling side by side on it with their hands put together and their faces turned up to the empty sky, the boulder standing beyond them.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the two kneeling figures across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; her joined hands come up in front of her chin; his head tips back further toward the sky.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock, level with a kneeling child's eye and five long strides from the shawl, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A girl of five in a pink frock kneels at the LEFT of CENTRE at half the frame height with her hands put together, a gaunt bearded man kneels beside her at the RIGHT at three quarters of the frame height with his hands put together, the giant boulder stands beyond them at the LEFT, and the spread grey shawl holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: she thinks they are hens -> the two of them kneeling

shots.frame: Medium looking up past the two kneeling heads: the crowns of a golden head and a grizzled one standing into the bottom of frame, the bare steel-blue sky filling everything above them, three dark birds set along a rock ledge at the top corner.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the sky across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; the nearest bird's folded wing lifts where the wind crosses the ledge; the two heads tip further back below.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock beside the shawl, level with a kneeling child's shoulder and two long strides from them, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: Bare steel-blue sky fills the frame, the crowns of a golden head and a grizzled head stand up into the BOTTOM of frame at a quarter of the frame height, and three dark birds stand along a grey rock ledge at the TOP RIGHT at the height of a thumb each
shots.turn: the two of them kneeling -> what they are kneeling to

shots.frame: Medium close of the two asleep in the boulder's shade: the girl's golden head down on the man's chest with her round white arms about his brown neck, his grizzled beard come down into her curls, both faces still.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the two sleeping faces across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; his head settles further down into her hair; her hand slackens open on his shoulder.
shots.camera: at the shaded foot of the boulder, level with a lying man's chest and two long strides from them, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A gaunt bearded man lies against the boulder at the CENTRE of frame at four fifths of the frame height with his eyes closed, a girl's golden head rests on his chest at the CENTRE at a third of the frame height with her arms about his neck, the shaded rock fills the TOP and LEFT, and bare grey rock holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: the two of them kneeling -> the two of them asleep

shots.frame: Wide of the far edge of the alkali plain from the plateau: a low wide column of pale dust standing up off the salt along the horizon and drifting, the snow-flecked peaks behind it, the flat grey-white plain between.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the dust column across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the column of dust climbs higher off the plain and spreads along the horizon; the heat shimmer crosses the salt below it.
shots.camera: at the edge of the plateau, level with a standing man's eye and four long strides from the drop, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: Steel-blue sky fills the TOP of frame, a low wide column of pale dust stands up off the horizon across the CENTRE at a third of the frame height, the snow-flecked peaks stand behind it at the height of a thumbnail, and the flat grey-white plain holds the BOTTOM of frame
shots.turn: the two of them asleep -> something on the plain

shots.frame: Full of the plain through the haze: the canvas tilts of heavy waggons and the shapes of mounted men showing dark through the drifting dust in a straggling line that runs from one edge of frame to the other.
shots.motion: The camera tracks a long stride to the right across the whole shot; the line of waggons and riders comes on across the salt at a walking pace; the dust rolls up from the wheels behind them.
shots.camera: at the edge of the plateau, level with a standing man's chest and four long strides from the drop, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A straggling line of white canvas waggon tilts and mounted men runs across the CENTRE of frame from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge at a third of the frame height, drifting pale dust stands above them to the TOP of frame, and the flat grey-white plain holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: something on the plain -> ten thousand people

shots.frame: Full of the caravan on the march: a heavy waggon with a white canvas tilt filling the near side of frame, a team of dusty oxen in the yoke, spoked wheels turning in powdery white alkali, riders in brown and grey homespun alongside with rifles slung.
shots.motion: The camera tracks a long stride to the left across the whole shot; the spoked wheels turn in the alkali at a walking pace; the yoked oxen come forward against the traces.
shots.camera: on the powdery ground beside the column, level with a standing man's chest and three long strides from the nearest wheel, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A white canvas waggon tilt stands at the LEFT of frame from the height of a standing man to the TOP, a team of dusty oxen stands in the yoke at the CENTRE at the height of a standing man, spoked wheels stand in powdery white alkali at the BOTTOM LEFT, and the line of following waggons runs away to the RIGHT
shots.turn: ten thousand people -> a nation walking

shots.frame: Medium along the wheels: women in plain bonnets walking beside the turning spokes with bundles against their hips, small children walking at their skirts, one child looking out from under a white canvas tilt behind them.
shots.motion: The camera tracks a long stride to the left across the whole shot; the women walk forward beside the wheels at a walking pace; one child's head turns to follow the camera.
shots.camera: on the powdery ground beside the column, level with a standing woman's chest and three long strides from the wheels, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: Women in plain bonnets walk across the CENTRE of frame at four fifths of the frame height carrying bundles, turning spoked wheels stand behind them at the RIGHT at the height of a standing woman, small children walk at their skirts at the BOTTOM CENTRE at a third of the frame height, and powdery white dust holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: a nation walking -> and their children with them

shots.frame: Full of the halted vanguard at the foot of the bluff: a score of grave ironfaced men on horseback in sombre brown and grey homespun with rifles slung across their backs, the broken rock of the bluff rising steeply behind them.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the halted riders across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the nearest horse swings its head round against the rein; the dust comes down across the standing hooves.
shots.camera: on the powdery ground at the foot of the bluff, level with a mounted man's chest and five long strides from the nearest horse, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A score of mounted men in sombre homespun stand across the CENTRE of frame at the height of a standing man and a half with rifles slung across their backs, the broken rock of the bluff rises behind them from the LEFT to the TOP of frame, the flat grey-white plain opens at the RIGHT, and powdery white ground holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: and their children with them -> the men at the head of it

shots.frame: Medium up the precipitous slope: young men in homespun climbing the broken ledges on hands and feet with rifles across their backs, a small wisp of bright pink showing on the crag at the top of frame against the grey rock.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the climbing men across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; loose scree runs down the ledges under the climbers' boots; the wisp of pink lifts and falls where the wind crosses the crag.
shots.camera: on the broken rock at the foot of the slope, level with a climbing man's chest and four long strides below him, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: Young men in homespun stand on the broken ledges at the CENTRE of frame at half the frame height with rifles across their backs, the grey rock of the slope runs from the BOTTOM of frame to the TOP, and a small wisp of bright pink shows on the crag at the TOP CENTRE at the height of a thumb
shots.turn: the men at the head of it -> what they saw on the crag

shots.frame: Medium close of the gaunt man standing on the plateau facing the camera in his dark velveteen tunic, the girl in the pink frock at his hip with one hand closed on the cloth at his knee, sunburned men in homespun standing round out of focus.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the man across the whole shot, travelling a long stride; his hand comes down onto the child's golden head; his chin comes up.
shots.camera: on the plateau rock, level with a standing man's eye and four long strides from him, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A gaunt bearded man in a dark velveteen tunic stands at the CENTRE of frame at four fifths of the frame height facing the camera, a girl of five in a pink frock stands at his hip at the BOTTOM CENTRE at a third of the frame height with one hand closed on the cloth at his knee, sunburned men in homespun stand out of focus at both edges, and steel-blue sky holds the TOP
shots.turn: what they saw on the crag -> what he calls her

shots.frame: Medium of the driver's seat of the great waggon: a broad-headed clean-shaven man of about thirty in a black homespun coat sitting beside the driver with a brown-backed volume laid shut on his knee, the white canvas tilt behind him.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on the seated man across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; his hand comes off the brown-backed volume and rests on his knee; his head turns down toward the camera.
shots.camera: on the powdery ground below the waggon seat, level with a standing man's eye and five long strides from the seat, a 50mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A broad-headed clean-shaven man in a black homespun coat sits at the CENTRE of frame at three quarters of the frame height on a broad plank seat with a brown-backed volume laid shut on his knee, the white canvas tilt of the great waggon fills the TOP and RIGHT, and the heads of the crowd stand at the BOTTOM
shots.turn: what he calls her -> who decides

shots.frame: Close on the Prophet's face from below the waggon seat: the heavy clean-shaven jaw, the wide mouth closed, steady pale eyes looking down out of frame, the white canvas tilt bright behind his head.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in on his face across the whole shot, travelling a forearm; his eyes come down further toward the camera; his mouth opens once on a word.
shots.camera: on the powdery ground below the waggon seat, level with a seated man's chest and three long strides from his face, an 85mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A heavy clean-shaven face fills the CENTRE of frame at two thirds of the frame height with steady pale eyes looking down and the wide mouth closed, the bright white canvas tilt fills the TOP and both edges behind his head, and the black shoulder of his coat holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: who decides -> the terms

shots.frame: Wide of the whole caravan starting forward across the alkali plain: the line of white canvas tilts stretching from one edge of frame to the other, teams leaning into the yokes, riders moving up the flank, the snow-flecked peaks far beyond.
shots.motion: The camera pulls back off the caravan across the whole shot, travelling two long strides; the whole line of waggons comes forward across the salt at a walking pace; the dust rolls up behind the wheels and spreads.
shots.camera: on the powdery ground clear of the column, level with a standing man's eye and six long strides from the nearest wheel, a 35mm lens. The white afternoon sun stands high and a little behind the camera
shots.at_rest: A line of white canvas waggon tilts runs across the CENTRE of frame from the LEFT edge to the RIGHT edge at half the frame height, teams of oxen stand in the yokes below them, pale dust stands above the line to the TOP of frame, the snow-flecked peaks show at the TOP RIGHT at the height of a thumbnail, and the flat grey-white plain holds the BOTTOM
shots.turn: the terms -> on, to Zion

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: In the middle of the continent lies a desert that kept the world out for a century.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Fifteen hundred miles of it are marked out in bones.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: On the fourth of May, 1847, one man stood on the northern slope and looked for water.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: He was not old. Hunger and thirst had done the work of thirty years on him.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: He set down his rifle, and the grey bundle off his shoulder, harder than he meant to.

lines.speaker: lucy_ferrier_child
lines.text: You hurt me when you put me down.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: A child of five came out of the shawl in a pink frock somebody had kept clean.

lines.speaker: lucy_ferrier_child
lines.text: Kiss it better. That is what mother does.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: He had been three days finding a way to tell her, and she asked him in four words.

lines.speaker: john_ferrier
lines.text: Mother has gone on ahead. You will see her soon enough.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: She cried into her pinafore, and stopped, and wanted to know if they were going the same way.

lines.speaker: lucy_ferrier_child
lines.text: Do you mean we are going to die?

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: He told her they were. She laughed out loud, and said he had frightened her for nothing.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: If they were dying, she said, then they were only going to where her mother already was.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Three specks came up out of the north and grew.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: They settled on the ledge above him, bald-headed and patient, and she clapped to make them fly.

lines.speaker: lucy_ferrier_child
lines.text: Somebody else made this part. They forgot to put the water in.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: She laid the shawl out and showed him how to kneel, because he had forgotten how.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: One voice thin and one deep, and nothing above them but the birds and the sky.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Then she slept on his chest, and his head came down on hers, and he slept too.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Half an hour later the far edge of the plain began to smoke.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Ten thousand people were coming west, with their waggons and their oxen and their guns.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Women walked at the wheels with bundles, and their children walked in the dust beside them.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Twenty grave men rode at the head of it, and they halted under the bluff.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Riders saw a scrap of pink on the crag, climbed with rifles ready, and came back astonished.

lines.speaker: john_ferrier
lines.text: My name is John Ferrier. She is mine now. I am keeping her.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: The Prophet listened from his waggon seat, and gave them water on one condition.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: They could come as believers, he said, and he would carry no wolf in his fold.

lines.speaker: john_watson
lines.text: Ferrier took a faith he had never heard of, the whips cracked, and the desert let them go.
